title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Implant Cat 4, Day 30
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfz3jp8n
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Cleveland Clinic animal team euthanizes the animal

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the animal and prepare the surgical site.

substeps.instruction: Shave the abdomen.
Attach the animal to monitors in the surgery room.
Drape the animal.
Perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder via the urethra.

substeps.instruction: Apply surgilube to the 3.5Fr catheter.
Insert the catheter into the bladder through the urethra.
Advance the catheter until resistance is met, then pull back 2-3cm.

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Withdraw and measure urine from the bladder using gentle suction with a syringe.

substeps.instruction: Remove 5 mL of urine.
Measure the volume and save the urine for urinalysis.

steps.title: Perform Contrast CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 5 mL contrast and take a single CT image.
Add another 10 mL of contrast (total 15 mL) and take a single image.
Take a 3D CT image with 15 mL contrast:saline in the bladder.

steps.title: Set Up Urodynamics Recording
steps.instruction: Prepare the pressure recording system after transferring the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic.

substeps.instruction: Connect an external pressure transducer to a syringe pump on one end and tubing leading to the catheter on the other.
Configure Labview software to record pressure data.
Set the syringe pump fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute.

steps.title: Perform Round 1 Urodynamics
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record pressure using the pressure transducer and LabView.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at 2 mL/min.
Stop filling at 15 mL after detecting the leak point (leakage around the catheter).

steps.title: Perform Round 2 Urodynamics
steps.instruction: Repeat the saline fill and pressure recording process.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at 2 mL/min.
Stop filling at 14 mL after detecting the leak point (leakage around the catheter).
Withdraw 16 mL from the bladder.

steps.title: Harvest Bladder
steps.instruction: Remove the bladder and preserve it for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Remove the bladder.
Place the bladder in formalin for histological analysis.
